P.name: Divine Ascent
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayle''' ascends through four forms that each grant additional bonuses. She ascends upon spending a skill point at {{stil|experience|levels}} 1, 6, 11, and 16.
P.description2: {{sbc|Level 1 - Zealous:}} '''Kayle's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zeal'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 5 times. For each stack, she gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|6%|attack speed}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|30%|attack speed}}}}. At max stacks, she becomes ''Exalted'', gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Level 6 - Arisen:}} '''Kayle''' becomes {{tip|ranged}} and gains {{sti|range|350 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|525}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Level 11 - Aflame:}} '''Kayle''' gains 10% bonus {{tip|size}}. While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward that deals {{pplevel|20+3*(x-1)|11+x-1|formula=20 + 3 for every  level starting from level 11|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies it passes through. The ''wave'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description5: {{sbc|Level 16 - Transcendent:}} '''Kayle''' gains an additional {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|625}}, and permanently gains the full effects of ''Zealous''.

Q.name: Radiant Blast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' conjures a portal in front of her that faces the target direction, from which, after 0.25 seconds, a celestial sword launches forward.
Q.description2: The sword expands upon hitting an enemy, with targets struck in the area dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds, and inflicted with 15% '''reduced''' {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds. <!-- Changed the lethality and magic pen icons to armor and magic resistance icons. Shred is not the same as penetration: The former interacts with a stat, while the latter IS a stat. This change should be applied in general, I think. -->
Q.cast time: {{tt|Attack Windup Time|Cast time is equal to this period.}}

W.name: Celestial Blessing
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' and the target allied champion are {{tip|heal|healed}} and gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds from the start of the cast time.
W.leveling:
{{st|Heal|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|24 to 40}}% {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Celestial Blessing'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range, prioritizing the one with the lowest {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
W.description3: '''''Kayle''' can move during Celestial Blessing's cast time.''

E.name: Starfire Spellblade
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' kindles her blade, empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal additional {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} that is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. If '''Kayle''' is not yet ''{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Arisen}}'', this attack becomes {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|range|525 range}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Aflame}} Bonus:}} The attack explodes upon the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. This is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.description4: ''Starfire Spellblade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kayle's''' basic attack timer. Starfire Spellblade does not deal bonus damage against [[structure|structures]].''

R.name: Divine Judgment
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' grants herself or a target allied champion {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds from the start of the cast time, and conjures flaming swords around herself.
R.description2: After {{fd|2.5}} seconds, she rains the swords down around the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.description3: '''''Kayle''' can move during Divine Judgment's cast time.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 80}}|Begins at the start of cast time}}
